verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents centrally managed credentials: one-click OAuth and key-based auth for 3,000+ APIs, with tokens usable in code or pre-built actions. Connect also handles token storage and refresh, so users don't build auth flows themselves. Nothing in the evidence shows credentials being shared with teammates or any control over who can use which credential. Connect's per-user model (external_user_id) targets end-user accounts, not team governance. Missing for 10: team sharing of connected accounts, per-credential access controls/permissions, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
